package probe

import "os/exec"

// A generic function is a shape the check does not follow, and a command one
// builds with it carries a nil Env: in a file that imports os/exec, every
// FuncDecl with type parameters is a finding (P6). The e2e tier declares none,
// so nothing legitimate is refused.
func zero[T any](p *T) *T {
	return new(T)
}
